sloka: एवं मया महाभागा दृष्टा जनकनन्दिनी ।उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता त्वद्भक्त्या पुरुषर्षभ ।। ५.६५.१८ ।।।।
transliteration: evaṁ mayā mahābhāgā dṛṣṭā janakanandinī ।ugreṇa tapasā yuktā tvadbhaktyā puruṣarṣabha ।। 5.65.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "O bull among men I saw Janaki,the delight of Janaka, a formidable lady filled with devotion to you and richly endowed with austerity.
